title: Config Connector and Infrastructure Manager: the platform-native options

videos.script: Terraform is not the only way to describe Google Cloud in files. Google offers two of its own. {{two}} Config Connector turns resources into Kubernetes objects. A controller keeps them true, all the time. Change a bucket by hand, and it changes back. {{kcc}} Infrastructure Manager runs your Terraform for you. Google keeps the state, and a service account does the applying. {{im}} Same bucket, three descriptions. What differs is who acts, when, and what happens to a change made by hand. {{compare}} Neither of these runs on a laptop. So this lesson is read, not typed. By the end you can say which one fits a team, and why the shop stays where it is. {{end}}
